title: Luke's theory: Old Kingdom pharaohs were never buried in their pyramids, but in the south near Abydos

tellings.quote: I think he knew something that's invisible to us today that the pharaohs of the old kingdom are never buried in their pyramids and their tombs are down south.

plain: A researcher of ancient sites, Luke Caverns, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels' show in 2025, says the pharaohs of Egypt's Old Kingdom, the early age when the great pyramids were built, were never buried in their pyramids. He says their real tombs lie to the south, near Abydos, and suggests a later pharaoh, Amenemhat III, knew this. If true, the pyramids would not be the tombs they are usually taken to be.
